jobs_results.title: Data Scientist especialista en IA generativa
Generative AI Data Scientist Stager
jobs_results.description:
En Mango inspiramos y unimos mediante nuestra pasión por el estilo y la cultura. Estamos en más de 115 países y nuestra presencia online se extiende a más de 110 países. Nuestro equipo está formado por personas de 112 nacionalidades y en un 78% por mujeres.

Buscamos un/a

Generative AI Data Scientist Stager

¿CÓMO SERÁ TU DÍA A DÍA EN MANGO?

Estamos buscando un/a Data Scientist con interés en Natural Language Processing y Large Language Models para unirse al squad de IA Generativa en nuestro equipo de Data&Advanced Analytics.

Formarás parte del equipo que da forma a la inteligencia, estrategia y arquitectura de datos de Mango. El equipo de Advanced Analytics desarrolla algoritmos de Inteligencia Artificial dirigidos a optimizar los procesos y decisiones más desafiantes dentro de la industria del fashion retail.

El equipo de Advanced Analytics de Mango está formado por Data Scientists, Big Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Deep Learning Researchers y Software Engineers... que trabajan juntos en squads multidisciplinares para desarrollar algoritmos de aprendizaje automático de vanguardia aprovechando la última tecnología en plataformas de Big Data y computación distribuida.

Cada Uno De Los Squads De Advanced Analytics Tiene Como Objetivo Desarrollar y Evolucionar Algoritmos De Aprendizaje Automático Para Hacer Frente a Algunos De Los Principales Retos Técnicos y Empresariales De Mango
• Generative Artificial Intelligence squad: Equipo transversal responsable de impulsar iniciativas innovadoras relacionadas con algoritmos generativos (texto, imagen, video, etc) en el cual se incorporará la persona seleccionada. Este squad ha liderado el desarrollo de la plataforma de IA basada en LLM para los casos de uso internos. Además, es responsable de impulsar la transformación que se está llevando a cabo en los procesos creativos empleando modelos de IA de generación de imágenes. Este equipo realizará investigación de los diferentes algoritmos disponibles para evaluar su madurez y utilidad dentro de Mango para llevar a cabo pruebas de concepto y su posterior puesta en producción.
• Personalization Squad: Desarrollar algoritmos de Inteligencia Artificial para proporcionar una experiencia personalizada a los clientes del sitio web y de la App de Mango, incluyendo recomendaciones de producto, ajuste y tamaño, aprovechando las capacidades de despliegue en tiempo real y el flujo de clics en tiempo real.
• Pricing and Mark-Down Squad: Desarrollar algoritmos de aprendizaje automático que determinen las promociones y descuentos óptimos para optimizar el margen de la empresa durante el periodo de ventas.
• Purchasing/Production Squad: Desarrollar algoritmos de ciencia de datos para la detección temprana de best-sellers y para determinar cuántas unidades de cada producto y talla debe fabricar Mango durante la planificación de la temporada.

¿QUÉ HACE UN DATA SCIENTIST EN MANGO?

Como Data Scientist especializado en NLP y LLM formarás parte del equipo que trabaja en la investigación, definición, experimentación, prototipado y puesta en producción de soluciones innovadoras basadas en algoritmos generativos de última generación.
• Implementarás el prototipo de soluciones con algoritmos de Deep Learning para evaluar la viabilidad técnica y la calidad de los resultados.
• Trabajarás con modelos de Deep Learning complejos como los Large Language Models (LLM) para abordar múltiples casos de uso, implementando y refinando los prompts, empleando técnicas de Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAGs) y evaluando la calidad de los resultados.
• Participarás en pruebas de concepto para realizar el entrenamiento o fine tuning de estos modelos de acuerdo con las necesidades de cada caso de uso.
• Trabajarás con una gran variedad de datos (estructurados y no estructurados), definiendo las fuentes de datos relevantes y preparando el set de datos necesario para entrenar los modelos de Deep Learning.
• Estarás conectado a los últimos desarrollos en Deep Learning y podrás experimentar con técnicas avanzadas de LLMs.

¿QUÉ ESPERAMOS DE TI?
• Que estés estudiando un Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas o Estadística o Ciencia de Datos con buenos resultados académicos.
• Tengas capacidad para programar (o facilidad de aprendizaje) en Python, R o Scala.
• Que tengas interés en emplear modelos avanzados de Inteligencia Artificial.

¿QUÉ NOS HACE ESPECIALES?
• Formarás parte de una empresa internacional en plena transformación tecnológica, como parte del equipo de Data & Advanced Analytics de Mango.
• 6 meses de prácticas (remuneradas).
• Transporte gratuito de empresa desde Barcelona y el Vallès para llegar a nuestras oficinas centrales.
• Posibilidad de teletrabajo en un 50%.

jobs_results.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic Data Scientist to join our dynamic Data Science team at TUI Musement. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical team to develop AI products that address key business challenges and provide personalized solutions for customers. You have the opportunity to work with cross-functional teams to collect feedback, optimize, iterate, and learn. As the Data Science Team, we are leveraging Generative and predictive AI to develop innovative solutions to enhance customer experience and automate business operational processes. You will play a big role in implementing and integrating AI at TUI Musement.

TUI Musement is the world’s leading provider of destination experiences. With 9,000 diverse employees in 49 countries and head office locations including Palma de Mallorca, Milan, Luton and Hannover. We offer 14 million guests a portfolio of excursions, activities, tours, transfers and guest services. TUI Musement is... part of TUI Group, the world's leading tourism group.

ABOUT THE JOB:
• Work directly with product owners, data analysts, data engineers, and machine learning engineers to design, develop, deploy and monitor AI and machine learning products that are standard and scalable
• Take a role in the adoption and integration of Generative AI in evolving business operations
• Directly engage with business stakeholders to deeply understand their problems and ensuring that solutions are tailored to their specific needs
• Monitor the performance of models, and find areas of improvements
• Follow best practices in data science and machine learning to ensure high-quality, sustainable, and efficient solutions
• Develop and fine-tune machine learning models to address and resolve specific business requirements, focusing on both accuracy and practical applicability
• Utilizing cutting-edge technology to drive business innovation and efficiency
• Stay updated with the latest developments in AI and data science to continuously seek to apply new techniques and methodologies to improve existing processes

ABOUT YOU:
• Bachelor or Master’s degree in Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or similar fields nice to have
• Solid hands-on experience in Data Science and Machine Learning
• Familiarity with recommendation systems and prescriptive analytics
• Proficiency with Python, SQL and Machine Learning libraries and framework
• Experience in the development of Machine Learning Models and applying statistical methods
• Experience building solutions using container and orchestration technologies
• Data-driven, innovative, and highly efficient in problem-solving and execution
• Excellent communicator and very good level of English are required
• Experience with Snowflake is highly valuable
• Experience with Generative AI and large language models nice to have
• Knowledge of AWS cloud nice to have
• Knowledge of NLP models including transformers nice to have

About Our Offer
• Competitive salary and benefits as standard
• Career progression opportunities in more than 50 countries worldwide
• Develop yourself as part of a friendly, richly diverse and virtual international team
• Exceptional approach to your learning - access to free learning platforms & language lessons

TUI Musement is a leading Tours & Activities business. It combines a scalable digital platform with local service delivery, to offer excursions, activities, tickets and transfers in more than 50 countries worldwide. There are over 130,000 ‘things to do’ in all major holiday and city destinations, which are distributed through B2B partners, via the Musement and TUI websites and direct to TUI customers. We also offer services to cruise lines through Intercruises Shoreside & Port Services in ports worldwide. TUI Musement sold around 10 million excursions, tours and activities delivered by our international colleagues located around the world and is one of the major growth areas of TUI Group.

In 2018, TUI’s Tours & Activities division acquired Musement, a leading traveltech start-up. Following a two-year transition period, both became one fully integrated business - known as TUI Musement - combining the global reach, strong resources and high quality in-destination service delivery of TUI, with the digital capabilities, agile working methodology and start-up mindset of Musement.

We love to see your uniqueness shine through and inspire the future of travel. If you would like to read more about what Diversity & Inclusion means to us simply visit Our DNA.

#TUIJobs #TUIMusement

jobs_results.title: Senior Data Scientist (w/f)
jobs_results.description:
Are you proactive, adventurous and looking for new high professional challenges? We have an opportunity that might interest you!

At T-Systems, we are a team of around 28,000 people worldwide, making us one of the world's leading providers of integrated end-to-end solutions.

Our soul is our people, who celebrate the culture of courageous and curious innovation. It doesn't matter when or where you work. It's about doing the work that matters. That's why we'll do everything we can to give you every opportunity to develop, offering you a supportive network, great technology, a new working environment and the freedom to work autonomously.

🔎 Role description: Data Scientist or Python Data analytics Developer with pandas, kubernetes and aws are good to have to be able to operate in project environment

About de Project:

The developed solution is a cloud-based platform that empowers customers with a sea load of data. Using a SaaS model, the platform securely connects machinery in the... field to an Amazon cloud. Moreover, the platform delivers the data analytics you need to take fleet confidently into the future.

The platform has customizable dashboards to display the data you can utilize to monitor the operation of your machinery. The data can also be used in other digital products and services provided by us. Data allows responding with speed and intelligence in emergencies and to proactively consult to prevent issues and optimize operation.

Qualifications:
• Primary: Python, Pandas (for times series), good communication, full lifecycle ownership, AWS (use storage efficiently, deploy to the cloud)
• Secondary: Kubernetes/EKS, Jenkins, SageMaker Notebooks.
• Good English is a must for this role, as all job interactions are in English. Strong soft skills are a benefit (communication, proactivity, engagement)
• CV in English is required

🤲We Offer you:

· Value-oriented innovation culture combined with unique resources and capabilities

· Diverse team with continuous top rates on employee satisfaction

· Worldwide collaboration with top domain experts and inspiring leaders

· Access to broad horizontal and vertical learning and training opportunities

· Hybrid work Model

· Flextime

· Flexible Benefits Plan

· Life and accident Insurance

· Nursery Ticket

· And much more!

Come to the Magenta side!

T-Systems Iberia will only process CVs of candidates who meet the requirements specified for each offer

jobs_results.title: Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
• Empresa del sector del ocio y el entretenimiento.|Ubicada en Sant Cugat del Vallés.

About Our Client

Empresa del sector del ocio y del entretenimiento ubicada en Sant Cugat el Vallés y que se encuentra en constante crecimiento.

Job Description
• Utilizar técnicas estadísticas avanzadas para analizar grandes conjuntos de datos y extraer patrones significativos.
• Identificar oportunidades y desafíos a través de la exploración y análisis de datos.
• Desarrollar modelos predictivos y prescriptivos para mejorar la toma de decisiones.
• Evaluar y mejorar continuamente el rendimiento de los modelos existentes.
• Aplicar algoritmos de aprendizaje automático para resolver problemas empresariales.
• Colaborar con otros equipos para implementar soluciones basadas en modelos de machine learning.
• Crear visualizaciones efectivas para comunicar resultados y tendencias a diferentes audiencias.
• Desarrollar cuadros de mando interactivos para facilitar la toma de decisiones.

The Successful... Applicant
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para trabajar en equipo.
• Comprensión de los principios de la ética en el manejo de datos y la privacidad.
• Experiencia comprobada en proyectos de análisis de datos y modelado predictivo.
• Conocimiento de lenguajes de programación como Python o R.
• Experiencia práctica con herramientas y bibliotecas de machine learning.
• Habilidades sólidas en visualización de datos utilizando herramientas como Tableau, Power BI, etc.
• Título universitario en Ciencias de la Computación, Estadísticas, Matemáticas, Ingeniería u otro campo relacionado.

What's on Offer

Oportunidades de carrera y desarrollo profesional.

Contact: Alejandro Mediano

Quote job ref: JN-112023-6242931

Brand: PP

jobs_results.title: Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
¡Capitole Consulting sigue creciendo y queremos hacerlo contigo!

En Capitole queremos ampliar nuestro equipo de Data, con dos Data Scientist expertos en machine learning. Buscamos perfil senior con amplios conocimientos en modelos de Machine Learning tradicional (mínimo 4 años) y uno junior con al menos 2 años de experiencia.

¿Qué Buscamos?
• Una persona con capacidad de aprendizaje muy alta, para entender un ecosistema desafiante.
• Desarrollo sobre Vertex AI.
• Capacidades de analista funcional para la toma de requerimientos, detección de oportunidades y desarrollo de nuevas POC.
• Conocimientos en Generative AI de al menos 1 año.
• Conocimientos en Google Cloud Platform.
• Conocimiento en tratamiento de datos no estructurados como pdf o word.
• Conocimientos de Python (Pandas, DASK, SKLearn, Matplot, Seaborn, TensorFlow, Keras)
• Conocimientos en Git.
• Habilidades comunicativas.
• Espíritu de equipo.
• Mente abierta y proactividad para hacer propuestas de mejora.

Idiomas... inglés B2/C1 imprescindible.

Valorable:
• Master en Data Science o Big Data
• Conocimientos de puesta en producción, monitorización y reentrenamiento de modelos de predicción.
• Experiencia trabajando con datos en formato mf4, cdfx y MatLab

Somos geniales, pero contigo lo seremos más

Para ello tendrás:

· Presupuesto de 1.200€ en formación individual para que lo utilices en lo que tú quieras (eventos tecnológicos, libros, formaciones, certificaciones etc.).

· Seguimiento con tu equipo todos los meses para tener un continuo feedback.

· Teletrabajo.

· Flexibilidad horaria para ayudarte a conciliar tu vida profesional / familiar.

· Seguro médico privado pagado íntegramente por Capitole

· Retribución flexible (tickets restaurante, transporte y/o guardería).

· Andjoy (Gymforless)

· Descuentos en grandes marcas para emplead@s (Club Capitole)

Para que conozcas a toda la familia:

· Team Buildings cada dos meses. ¡No te puedes perder la fiesta de verano o la cena de Navidad!

· Equipo de fútbol patrocinado por Capitole.

· Comunidades tecnológicas para que compartas tus conocimientos e ideas con los demás equipos. ¡¡¡Compartir el conocimiento interno es fundamental!!!

· ¡Por último y no menos importante un EQUIPAZO! ¿Aún no nos conoces? ¡¡Descúbrenos!! https://capitole-consulting.com/

Mira lo que opinan de nosotros https://www.glassdoor.es/Opiniones/Capitole-Consulting-Opiniones-E2060890.htm

No dudes en enviarnos tu perfil, ¡estamos deseando conocerte

jobs_results.title: Health & Social Care Senior Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
NTT DATA Spain is looking for a Senior Data Scientist willing to improve decision-making within the health and social care sector through data and advanced analytics. The job would imply working for clients such as regional health and social care systems, public and private social care agents, and international organizations such as the European Commission or the WHO. The position will be based either in Madrid, Barcelona or Seville. Remote working is allowed.

Qualifications: bachelor’s or master’s degree in life sciences (biology, biomedicine, biomedical engineering, or biotechnology) as well as specialization in AI, Data Science or Business analytics will be highly valuable.

Experience: Previous experience as a Data Scientist and/or statistician in healthcare, pharma, or social care projects.

Responsibilities:
• Business analytics consulting tasks to translate healthcare and social care needs into analytical solutions using data and AI.
• Ability to understand data sources and... databases' technological needs.
• Data analysis using descriptive and exploratory statistics.
• Modeling, including training and deployment of ML models.
• Project management and coordination of a team of 2-3 people.

Skills:
• Quantitative skills, including the ability to extract value from data and modeling.
• Machine Learning and visualization techniques
• Programming skills: at least Python or R
• Databases (including SQL)
• Communication skills
• Management skills.
• Valuable:
• Knowledge of RWD assets such as medical claims, EHRs, and interoperability standards such as OpenEHR, OMOP...
• Expertise with clinical data standards, medical terminologies, and ontologies.
• Experience working with clinical databases and HIS

jobs_results.title: 40575MKP -DATA SCIENTIST (MIMARK)
jobs_results.description:
This offer is part of the Job Market Place of Talent in face-to-face format organized by Barcelona Activa in the CONNECTION DAY (Bio & HealthTech) in collaboration with the Cluster CataloniaBio & Health Tech on Tuesday May 7 from 15h to 17:30h.

The company MIMARK DIAGNOSTIC needs to fill vacancy of: DATA SCIENTIST

Only people who meet the requirements requested by the company will be notified.

Attendance and details will be confirmed via email.

Once shortlisted you will be required to be available for the Talent Market Place: Tuesday 7th May (afternoon). From 15h to 17:30 h.

Functions and tasks

MiMARK is an In Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) spin off company from Vall Hebron Research

Institute (VHIR) created in 2021 and focused on improving Women's Health.

Specialized in the development and validation of clinically impactful biomarkers in

gynecological fluids to provide innovative diagnostics across gynecology indications. In

MiMARK envision these fluids as the next liquid biopsy in... the gynecological arena to provide easy to access and reliable diagnostics.

Their first product, WomEC, is an IVD immunoassay-based technology which includes

biomarkers and algorithm for a high-efficiency diagnosis of endometrial cancer. Our

product is currently in prototype development, and we aim to start clinical validation

phases by 2024.

This company is growing in portfolio, including development of an IVD for Endometriosis diagnosis.

Data Scientist who will help to drive data scientist activities within MIMARK, with a special focus on data analysis and design and validation of algorithms.

In addition, the candidate will be responsible for data management processes and

coordinate the development of software tools.

The perfect candidate is a geek in data science who has a mathematics/statistical/data

processing and/or closely related background with experience in bioinformatics,

biomarker research and algorithm development, and eventually competent in artificial

intelligence (AI); preferably with experience on working with clinical and molecular data.

It's a unique opportunity to work with a multidisciplinary and highly passionate and committed team to bolster the know-how of the company and achieve

the next step for gynecological diagnostics.

Responsibilities

Execute biomarker and clinical research using multiomic and clinical data:

seeking for novel biomarkers, integration of multiomics, elucidating altered

molecular pathways of the disease, etc.
• Design and validation of algorithms, from linear regression to machine learning

methods; and eventually AI.
• Interpreting results, discussion with team members and reporting.
• Responsible for providing statistical experimental design and analysis, in all

phases of product development, including clinical trials.

March 2024
• Knowhow in data analysis, structuring, database development and data

management.
• Provide general data management to the project, as well as data quality checks

and regular verifications.
• Coordinate the design and development, testing, validation and maintenance

of software tools.
• Benefits

We would like you to profit from joining a team of talented people that share the passion

to develop minimally invasive diagnostics based on gynecological fluids to improve

women health. We would like to offer you:
• Full-time job.
• Great location in Barcelona. Remote working can be considered.
• Entrepreneurial environment and great team!
• Development of your professional career within an expanding StartUp.
• Salary: 35.000 - 45.000 salary According to value

Requisits:
• Requirements
• Ph.D. or master's degree in Computer science, Mathematics, Statistics or a

closely related field.
• Experience in bioinformatics and biomarker research.
• Understanding of Mathematical modelling, including logistic regression and

more complex models, such as Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, AI, and

their application to resolving intricate challenges.
• Programming skills in R and Python frameworks.
• Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
• Advanced level of English.
• Strong communication and presentation skills, including translation of complex

concepts in clear, concise, and meaningful ways, that a non-technical audience

can easily understand.
• Organized, proactive, and committed.

We will value
• Experience in working with clinical and proteomic data.
• Having worked in an ISO quality environment and/or biotech/pharma industry

environment.
• Understanding of the software development lifecycle; complying with IVD

standards.
•

jobs_results.title: Data Scientist
jobs_results.description:
At QUANT AI LAB, we continue to develop the most advanced artificial intelligence and analytics solutions in the market, always from the forefront and with established technical knowledge. Joining QUANT AI LAB means joining an adventure where each member is an important part of this project, and each part is essential to make it a reality.

On this occasion, we are looking for a Senior Data Scientist who possesses a deep and solid knowledge of artificial intelligence techniques, their design, conceptualisation, development and implementation in production.

Requirements
• Bachelor's degrees (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, etc.).
• At least 8 years of experience as Data Scientist.
• Strong experience in implementing machine learning solutions in the cloud (preferably AWS).
• Expertise in managing cloud AWS.
• Fluency in the use of Pyspark.
• Expertise in managing database SQL.
• Strong experience with Python.
• Bilingual level of English. French will be... positively considered.
• Deep understanding of predictive modeling, machine-learning, clustering and classification techniques, and algorithms.

At QUANT AI Lab, what we offer:
• Contribute to the development of an international company in continuous growth and developing cutting-edge projects and products.
• Integrate a multidisciplinary team with high-level professional and academic training, composed of some of the leading experts in the area of artificial intelligence, advanced analytics and data processing.
• The opportunity to work directly with clients of international stature, and some of the largest companies in the country and the world.
• A collaborative, entrepreneurial and supportive work environment, and a young and dynamic team where everyone supports each other to grow together.
• A fun and friendly atmosphere and festive events (afterworks, seminars...).
• Permanent contract and a very competitive salary, to be determined according to profile and experience
